STEP 2 - Vessel size:
a) Type: square plates are typically 20-30 cm; this one looks large, so about 26 cm.
b) Reference: the cubed potatoes and fruit pieces are roughly 2-3 cm each. The plate spans roughly 9-10 strawberry-length-equivalents across (a strawberry is about 3-4 cm long), giving about 27-30 cm. Blueberries (~1.5 cm) across the plate would be too many to count directly, but the watermelon wedges (~6 cm) fit about 4-5 across the width, which suggests ~25-28 cm.
